column1: # Shared dotfiles manifest — single source of truth.
# Read by BOTH home-manager/dotfiles.nix (to build macOS symlinks) and
# scripts/dotfiles-sync.sh (to copy/diff on Omarchy). Keep it plain TSV so the
# shell script works standalone, before nix is available.
# columns: repo_path <TAB> live_path (relative to $HOME) <TAB> kind <TAB> platforms
# Paths under ~/.config only. Files Omarchy never touches AND that live outside
# both platforms and are deliberately absent here.
